title: Modularize certificate rotation and NAT scaling lifecycle
creator: Ava Patel
description: Refactor our Terraform networking templates into two composable modules: (1) cert-rotation lifecycle helpers and (2) NAT-scaling primitives. The goal is to remove implicit side effects across workspaces, make certificate rollover safe during rolling deploys, and stabilize NAT gateway autoscaling to reduce transient IP churn and egress flaps.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce a cert_rotation module that supports: key material stored in customer KMS-backed SSM, rotation Lambda with idempotent apply, and Terraform-less renewal hook for on-prem/private deployments.

Introduce a nat_scaler module that supports: target-based scaling (by flow metrics), warmup windows to avoid flapping, and graceful replacement for NAT gateways without changing public IPs when possible.
All existing environments (prod/us-east-1, staging/eu-west-1) can be migrated with a zero-downtime plan and no manual state surgery.
CI runs show plan/drift noise reduced by >60% for networking overlays in representative workspaces.
Documentation and runbook updated and a tabletop run completed with SRE/Oncall.
Automated smoke test (ingress-egress + TLS handshake) passes in canary after rollout.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Ava Patel: Created ticket after postmortem on egress instability during cert rotation. Decision: split work into two modules to avoid tight coupling between cert lifecycle and NAT orchestration.

implementation_notes: Strategy: create two small modules published to our internal Terraform registry. Keep a thin adaptor in overlay templates so adoption is gradual. Use feature-flagged rollout: overlay switches to modules in canary workspace, then staged rollout across regions. Preserve existing state by importing SSM param with previous fingerprint and marking replaced resources with lifecycle meta when necessary.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Cross-account IAM during rotation could fail for Dedicated customers. Mitigation: add preflight IAM validation and fallback to operator-triggered rotation.
Risk: Public IP churn when replacing NAT gateways. Mitigation: opt-in preserve_ip boolean and recommended use of EIP pooling for high-stability workloads.
Risk: Terraform plan noise during migration. Mitigation: provide scripted migration helper that performs import and staged apply; document manual steps.
Risk: Lambda cold start impacting rotation window. Mitigation: keep rotation window retry logic and exponential backoff; prefer scheduled maintenance windows for large fleets.
